pkgmetadata.longdescription: Qoder CLI is Qoder's command-line coding agent. It provides an interactive terminal interface for AI-assisted software development, with MCP support. This package installs the prebuilt upstream binary.
Qoder CLI 是 Qoder 推出的命令行编程智能体, 在终端中提供交互式 界面, 辅助完成软件开发任务, 支持 MCP。本软件包安装上游预编译的 二进制文件。
